name: burglar_rat_each_opponent_discards_in_three_seats
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, each opponent discards a card.' Three players. Burglar Rat enters under seat 0: seat 1 discards one of its two cards and seat 2 one of its two (each its own choice, from its own hand); seat 0 discards nothing (its hand: its own card and the card it drew, CR 103.8c).
